title: Weighted top-tail to truncated-CCR defect transfer bridge
question: Does the weighted top-tail condition required by the truncated CCR defect imply the unweighted defect amplitude tends to zero, independently of any Q3 dynamics?
method: Use the exact finite oscillator defect [q_n,p_n]-iI=-i*n*P_top and represent a normalized vector tail by p_n=<psi_n,P_top psi_n>.
Formalize the scalar identity n*sqrt(p_n)=sqrt(n^2*p_n) for n>=0.
Apply continuity of the real square-root map at zero to the hypothesis n^2*p_n -> 0.
Compile the general implication and rational fixture in the pinned Lean toolchain without importing any Q3 numerical implementation.
finding: Lean R278 compiles without errors. The exact scalar bridge is proved: any supplied nonnegative top-tail sequence with n^2*p_n tending to zero has truncated-CCR defect amplitude n*sqrt(p_n) tending to zero. The rational fixture n=8, p=1/64 gives both weighted defect and defect amplitude equal to 1.
decision_reason: This isolates the precise analytic interface between the already-derived finite truncated-CCR defect and the missing Q3 domain estimate. It removes a possible ambiguity about whether a squared n-weighted tail is strong enough for vector defect convergence, while leaving the substantive uniform tail estimate untouched.
boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing scalar Lean bridge only; no Q3 Gibbs tail, evolved-history tail, source/volume/orientation/beta uniformity, modular-history estimate, direct D/delta-D Cauchy, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A, or Pre-A conclusion.
next_action: Prove the weighted top-tail estimate for the selected Q3 local carrier uniformly in cutoff, volume, source, orientation, beta, and history length, or register the first exact failure before any direct D/delta-D or common-alpha promotion.
no_overclaim: R278 proves only a scalar limit implication and a rational fixture; it does not establish its hypothesis for the actual Q3 regulator or any QFT state.

qft_interface.open: The actual Q3 Gibbs/evolved-history weighted tail, unbounded common-core transfer, source/volume-uniform modular history, direct D/delta-D Cauchy, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A, and Pre-A.

adversarial_review.check: The proof uses n>=0 to replace sqrt(n^2) by n; no sign is hidden.
The weighted convergence is an explicit premise; R278 does not manufacture it from finite data.
The Lean implication is stronger than needed and does not assume p_n is a Gibbs or history probability.
The bridge is linked to the exact n-weighted defect condition but contains no unbounded operator-domain theorem.
No Q3 uniformity, common dynamics, OS/KMS/GNS, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A, or Pre-A status is changed.
